claim_scope: Discovery experiment only; no universal selector theorem; no SAT_IN_P claim; no P_vs_NP claim.
substrate: canonical CNF plus generic incidence/constraint structure only

discovery_blindness.allowed: surface-independent generic structural statistics and exact local constraint relations

hypothesis_language.H3: generic choice-conflict relation carrier: positive choice blocks + disjoint complete negative-conflict components, represented as a bipartite incidence relation
hypothesis_language.generation: fixed order H0,H1,H2,H3; no adaptive expansion; no search-until-success

discovery_budget.time_bound: O(poly(|F|)) with explicit linear/quadratic graph scans only

hidden_family.provenance_for_evaluator: bounded-degree graph functional pigeonhole family FPHP(G) with |L|=n+1, |R|=n, left degree 3, boundary-expander hardness fixture

literature_baseline.resolution_width: Omega(n) for suitable degree-3 boundary-expander FPHP(G) family

controls.CONTROL_A: structural decoys with matched coarse statistics but broken exact carrier semantics
controls.CONTROL_B: cross-family CNFs surviving generic preprocessing but not exact for H3
controls.CONTROL_D: semantically preserved syntactic reencodings: variable renaming, clause permutation, variable permutation, duplicate/tautology normalization and equivalent harmless auxiliary wrappers

certificate_firewall.SAT: discovered relation -> saturating matching -> reconstruct assignment -> replay on original F
certificate_firewall.UNSAT: discovered relation -> independently verified deficient-set certificate -> verify neighborhood relation and inequality against original F
